from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow data from one company's 10-Q filing"""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Period ending date in YYYY-MM format")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities (should be positive for eligibility)")
    investing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing activities (should be negative for eligibility)")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of amounts: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt showing the cash flow figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
